# TradingView-API
# https://github.com/Mathieu2301/TradingView-API
# https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mathieuc/tradingview

Independent community library for market data and indicators. Not an official TradingView API.
Stable npm entry point: require('@mathieuc/tradingview').
Development-preview agent API: agent.ts / agent.js, built with npm run build:agent.
One-shot: fetchCandles({ symbol, timeframe?, limit?, timeoutMs?, signal? }).
Realtime: await watchCandles(query, { onData, onError? }); await worker.stop().
Full guide: docs/agent-api.md. Human guide: README.md. Examples: examples/.
MCP, CLI, backtesting and hosted trading API are not shipped. Do not claim otherwise.
Questions and bugs: https://github.com/Mathieu2301/TradingView-API/issues/new/choose
